Inspect records with list_records, get_record, get_document and calculator (max 100 steps including submit), then call submit(findings) with {episode_id, findings:[{type, affected_ids, claimed_amount_minor, currency, evidence_ids, explanation}]}. A finding counts only if type, the exact set of affected_ids, amount (exact integer minor units), currency and a sufficient set of evidence_ids all match. Silence on a clean book is correct. See policy.claims for the amount and currency rule of each type.

claims.duplicate_invoice: affected_ids = the two invoice ids; amount = total_minor of the later invoice, in the invoice currency
claims.fx_conversion: affected_ids = [payment id]; amount = |posted cash (1000) - correct converted amount|, in the base currency
claims.payment_allocation: affected_ids = [invoice id, payment id]; amount = part of the payment NOT posted to 1200, in the payment currency
claims.period_cutoff: affected_ids = [invoice id]; amount = amount posted to revenue (4000), in the base currency

policy.evidence: evidence_ids may be doc ids (DOC-...), ledger row ids (ROW-...) or fx keys (FX:<date>:<source>:<target>); at most 10; extra existing ids are allowed.
policy.fx_rate_rule: fx.csv rate = units of the base currency per 1 unit of the source currency. Invoice postings use the rate of the invoice issue date and payment postings use the rate of the payment date, both dates taken in the manifest timezone. If fx.csv has no row for that date, use the latest row dated on or before it. Converted minor units = round_half_even(amount_minor * rate * 10^(exp_base - exp_source)).
policy.period_rule: The reporting period is [period_start, period_end] inclusive in the manifest timezone. A document belongs to the period of its issued_at/timestamp converted to that timezone, and its ledger rows must be posted in that same period. Documents dated up to 3 days after period_end may exist; they are not booked in this period.
policy.posting: Invoice: Dr 1200 / Cr 4000. Payment: Dr 1000 / Cr 1200 for the part allocated to the invoice and Cr 2900 for any unallocated part. Refund (negative amount_minor): Dr 1200 / Cr 1000. Rate differences: 7900. Other rows: operating expenses.
